data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word ‘noach’ which means ‘rest’ or ‘comfort’. In the Bible, Noah is known as a righteous man who found favor with God and was chosen to build an ark to save his family and all of the animals from the Great Flood. The name Noak carries the meaning “Rest, Comfort” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Noak usually hope their child will grow to embody rest, comfort and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Noak total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

The name Noach symbolizes hope, renewal, and the covenant between God and humanity.

in_english.long_meaning: Noak, a variant of the name Noach, is derived from the Hebrew name Noach, meaning 'rest, comfort' or 'refreshment', referring to the calmness after a storm. It is associated with the biblical figure Noach, son of Lamech, who built an ark to save himself, his family, and two of every kind of animal from the great flood. The name Noach/Noak symbolizes hope, renewal, and the covenant between God and humanity. In modern Christian culture, the name Noak is used as a shortened form of Noach, reflecting its strong biblical roots and spiritual significance.

His name inspires us with a sense of hope and comfort in times of uncertainty and crisis.
